manifesto.title: Manifesto
paragraphs: We make sunglasses for people who decide what gets seen.
Real power doesn't ask for attention. It controls it.
No hype. No algorithm. No middlemen. One price: $100.
Every pair carries one mark worth finding: gold, set with black onyx. Most people won't notice. That's the point.
Drops are limited, and the numbers we show are the real ones.
Forty-five days to exchange. Six months of warranty.

items.a: Yes. Every lens is polarized TAC (tri-acetate cellulose) with UV400 protection, which blocks 100% of UVA and UVB.

items.q: Can I get them with my prescription?
items.a: No. Darkest Shades are non-prescription sunglasses.

items.q: What is the emblem on the temple?
items.a: The God Cloud Device: a gold-tone emblem set with black onyx. It's on every pair.
Each drop has a date, a set number of pairs and an end. The numbers on the site come straight from inventory. The list hears first.
Exchange them within 45 days. Every frame lists its measurements, so you can compare with a pair you already own.
Six months against defects and scratches.

care.body: Care instructions to be confirmed with the factory (lens coating, acetate, onyx setting).

body: We build darkestshades.com to WCAG 2.2 AA.

The opening sequence is optional. It never plays if your device asks for reduced motion, and you can skip it from its first frame. Its fast sequences are built to stay below the flash thresholds in WCAG 2.3.1.
If something doesn't work for you, write to {supportEmail}.
